patch_description: Replace the clipped concentric-ring layout with a deterministic multistart nonlinear optimization of all 26 center coordinates and radii. The objective directly maximizes the total radius subject to square-boundary and pairwise non-overlap constraints. Starts are based on a dense square lattice with a displaced extra circle and small deterministic perturbations, allowing SLSQP to discover asymmetric boundary and layered configurations. A final common safety scaling guarantees validity despite floating-point optimizer tolerances, and the best valid result across several starts is returned.
